name: @cut/desktop
description: Electron shell that packages the Reelog web app as a native macOS application.
author: Reelog contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @cut/web dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/editor && CUT_DEV_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @cut/web exec cross-env NEXT_OUTPUT=export next build
